name: Dozzle
description: Live, searchable log viewer for every container, in the browser.
compose:
services:
  dozzle:
    image: amir20/dozzle:latest
    container_name: dozzle
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:8080"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
